item.title: Time slows down when I'm hungry
item.author: junyi.h@comp.nus.edu.sg (Junyi Hou)
item.description: confused On low-calorie days I notice every minute. The same desk hours feel three times longer than on a normal day. rough view Maybe hunger is just sharpening attention. Or maybe I am bored and reaching for snacks usually fills that gap.
item.content:encoded:
confused
On low-calorie days I notice every minute. The same desk hours feel three times longer than on a normal day.
rough view
Maybe hunger is just sharpening attention. Or maybe I am bored and reaching for snacks usually fills that gap.
